device_entry.name: MATLAB兼容HDF5文件导出器
device_entry.description: 用于创建和写入与 MATLAB 兼容的 HDF5 数据文件的软件组件，适合实验数据归档、批量保存及复数数据记录。
device_entry.description_en: A software component for creating and writing MATLAB-compatible HDF5 data files, suitable for experiment data archiving, batch data saving, and recording complex-valued data.
